Candidate.description:
A single knowledge item extracted from the input.

The primary output of the extraction stage; each candidate is triaged against existing knowledge before it is committed or discarded.

content.description: The captured tacit knowledge, as one self-contained claim.

kind.description: The kind of knowledge this item records.

suggested_references.description: External anchors the item refers to, used to connect it to related knowledge even when wording differs.

suggested_tags.description: Categorisation tags for the item. Always present; an absent field is a parse error.

KnowledgeKind.description: The kind of knowledge: fact (a verifiable piece of information), heuristic (a rule of thumb learned from experience), procedure (an ordered set of steps), or decision_record (a choice made and its rationale).

RelationHint.description:
An intra-batch relation hint between two candidates by index.

Emitted by the extraction agent to indicate that one candidate is derived from another within the same batch.

hint_type.description: The type of relation hinted at.

source_index.description: Index of the source candidate in the batch.

target_index.description: Index of the target candidate in the batch.

RelationHintType.description:
The type of an intra-batch relation hint emitted by the extraction agent.

Currently a single variant; the enum exists as an extension point for future hint types.

SuggestedReference.description: An external anchor a candidate refers to (a URL, file path, code symbol, or concept) that can connect items even when their wording differs.

description.description: Optional human-readable context for the anchor.

reference_type.description: What kind of anchor this is (e.g. `"url"`, `"file_path"`); free-form.

value.description: The anchor itself: the URL, path, symbol, or concept.

description: Extracted knowledge items and optional intra-batch relationship hints.

candidates.description: Knowledge items extracted from the input, each an atomic, self-contained claim. Empty when the input contains no extractable knowledge.

relation_hints.description: Derivation links between candidates in this batch. Empty unless one candidate is genuinely derived from another.

title: ExtractionOutput
